lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: It seems this place doesn't have any staff to take orders.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: It's an unmanned store where you order through the machine.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: What would you like to eat,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Nadia?

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: ... Hmph.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Nadia reaches out to touch the order screen,

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: but her fingers are unable to reach it.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Would you like to try standing up, Nadia?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I can hold your hand.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Just order for me.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: I want the top option.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Nada moves her wheelchair over to a table.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: We still have a long way to go.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Now that we've eaten, what should we do now?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Any thoughts, Nadia?

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: No. Why the hell are you asking me for?

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: You're the one who demanded that we hang out. You should be the one coming up with ideas.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I was only asking to be polite.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: I swear to...

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Do you have anything you want to do, Gym Rat?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Hmm... nothing comes to mind.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: How about we go somewhere with a lot of people then?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: There's usually all sorts of stuff to do where people congregate.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: There sure are a lot of people here. It's nice and lively here.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Everyone is excited and brimming with energy! I'm sure there's plenty to do here.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Why don't we go to the game center?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: They've even got paintball.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: That looks fu...

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Screech* *Rattle*

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Nadia moves her wheelchair to another spot.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: This isn't gonna be easy.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I knew it would be like this. Let's go somewhere else.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: How about an exhibition, then?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Not the most exciting option, but it's not a terrible idea.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Yes, it is. Exhibitions are horrible.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Screech* *Rattle*

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Was my suggestion really that bad?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Don't take it personally.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I'm thirsty. Should we get something to drink?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Good idea.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Boring.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Screech* *Rattle*

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I feel like she's just saying no automatically at this point.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Yes, I think so.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Nadia shoots down every single suggestion Rumani and I bring up, quickly scooching past us.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: After a while, her wheelchair stops

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: in front of a store which sells running shoes.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: ... Do you like exercising?

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Yeah. I used to do track and field.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Oh really? That's amazing.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Not that it matters.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: I probably won't ever be able to do it again.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: You're feeling sorry for me,

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: aren't you?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: No, I...

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: It's okay. You're not wrong to feel that way.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Yes, you're pathetic.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Rumani! You shouldn't say...!

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Is that what you wanted to hear?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: It's not, right?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Then why are you saying something when you don't mean it?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: When I heard your story,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I knew I was right.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I wanted to help

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: get you running again,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: back into track and field.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: When I first touched your legs, I thought you might have done track before.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Don't pretend like you know me.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: You're right, I don't know anything about you. That's why I'm curious.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: What I do know about you is this:

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: There were no complications with your surgery.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Yet, from one day, you weren't able to stand up.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: On top of that, there were no signs of paralysis, nor any issues with your muscles or your nerves.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: That means there is nothing physically wrong with you.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I'm going to be frank with you.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Is the reason you can't walk psychological?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: When most rehab patients hear that they can walk again, they try harder than ever, because they want to walk again as soon as possible.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Even if they fall down hundreds of times, they never lose their motivation and give in.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: You, on the other hand, have been defensive from the very start, and seem devoid of any motivation to walk again. You're only obsessed with being right.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: You give up far too easily.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: All I can come up with is that the primary reason behind you being unable to walk is psychological.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Do you have some kind of trauma?

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Why should I tell you?

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: I'm not going to get proper physical therapy anyway.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Because I want to get you back into track and field.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: To be honest, at first, I fixated on you because you reminded me of my past self.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: But now, after hearing you used to run track,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I genuinely want to help you get back to that.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I usually don't fight for people this much.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I usually give up once they express a lack of interest in physical therapy.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: But I can't get you out of my mind, Nadia.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: So tell me.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Tell me why you can't walk.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: I used to be a track and field athlete.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: I was full of potential, poised to be the next big thing.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: A month before a competition, I overreached and stumbled over a hurdle.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: The hurdle broke, and I ended up getting injured.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: It was a pretty serious accident, and I had to get surgery.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: The surgery went well, and there was no issue with recovery.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: But when I returned and stood on the track, my leg suddenly cramped up.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: My body froze, and before I knew it, I collapsed on the spot.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: After that day,

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: I wasn't able to stand up.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: I had no idea if or when my legs would seize up again and my body would freeze.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: I tried all sorts of physical therapy programs, but nothing seemed to work.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: People would always tell me things like:

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Why don't you just close your eyes and stand up?

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: They don't know anything.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Nobody wants me to stand up more than me.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I knew it.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Thank you for telling me.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Why are you thanking me?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: This is the first time you've shared your story with me.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: All you've done before this is complain.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: You're afraid, is that it? You're scared that history might repeat itself.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: So you're subconsciously avoiding standing up.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: If you were to try and stand up,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: only to have the same debacle unfold, you'd break down all over again.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: But if you keep avoiding it, nothing will change.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: You'll be stuck living in a cage, consumed with fear.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: You have to push through this, even if there's a chance of the same incident reoccurring.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: So, with that being said, why don't you trust me?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I'll help you. Let me help you heal yourself.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I will help you walk.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: ... How will you do it?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: If you promise to go forward with it, I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: If I tell you my plan, and you decide not to do it, then I have no more cards to play.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: *Sigh*... I don't know whether this is smart or underhanded.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: If you're curious, why don't you give it a try?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: One thing I can say for certain is that it will be entirely different from any physical therapy you have experienced up until now.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I plan to incorporate some track and field activities, which I'm sure you'll love.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: I can rehabilitate myself while doing track and field?

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Okay. I'm in.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Good idea.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I look forward to working with you.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Rumani extends her hand towards Nadia.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: We don't need to shake hands, you idiot.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Why in the world are you so highly recommended?

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: You're so annoying.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Maybe it's because

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I'm so good at what I do.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: ... I'll see you tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: That went great.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Yes, what a relief.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: We finally found out why Nadia can't walk.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I didn't expect her to be a track and field athlete.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I knew as soon as I saw her.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Her musculature is extraordinary,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: and she has a competitive spirit.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Anyway, it looks like things are going to pick up starting tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I'll help as much as I can.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Thank you, Gym Rat.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Why don't we head to the gym and do 100 burpees?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: We'll need to hone our stamina for the days ahead.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: ... I'm okay, thanks.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Just 100, that's all. I'm not letting you leave until you do them.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: ... Fine.
